classes.name: vendor_cart
classes.description: Mobile wooden or metal pushcarts selling fruits, flowers, snacks, tea, tender coconut.

classes.name: double_parked_vehicle
classes.description: Two-wheelers, auto-rickshaws, app cabs, delivery vans halted/parked in vehicular lanes.

classes.name: illegal_stall
classes.description: Tarpaulin/bamboo roadside market extensions, vegetable crates, commercial display structures.

classes.name: pedestrian_spillover
classes.description: Group or stream of pedestrians walking on vehicular roadway due to obstructed or missing footpath.

annotation_rules.box_tightness: Draw tight bounding boxes around the physical footprint and superstructure.
annotation_rules.crowd_grouping: Annotate individual pedestrians if separated; annotate tight clusters with single 'pedestrian_spillover' box if boundary is contiguous.
annotation_rules.occlusion_threshold: Annotate objects if at least 25% visible.
annotation_rules.min_pixel_size: Skip objects smaller than 16x16 pixels in the distant background (> 80m from camera).
